title: Quantum-like cognition needs no quantum physical processes in the brain

statements.text: Quantum-like modeling is sharply distinguished from theories of genuine quantum physical processes in the brain such as those of Penrose and Hameroff: the brain is a macroscopic system whose information processing the quantum formalism describes.

sources.quote: The quantum-like approach should be distinguished from consideration of the genuine quantum physical processes in the brain (cf. Penrose and Hameroff). In our approach the brain is a macroscopic system which information processing can be described by the formalism of quantum theory
